purpose: Reuse Pipeline & Reply Coordinator, Offer & Asset Builder and Proposal Builder as the portfolio-wide Commercial Conversion receiver for qualified_opportunity_v1.

proposalApprovalPermit.rule: The permit must match the exact proposal ID, version and hash and must be unexpired. Silence or approval of another version is not approval.

commercialAcceptance.rule: Acceptance never proves payment. Payment facts require an authoritative payment-verification source.

rules: A qualified_opportunity_v1 handoff must be explicitly accepted or rejected.
Rejection returns ownership to Demand & Acquisition with typed remediation reasons.
Acceptance moves the opportunity into CONVERSION_ACTIVE and creates or updates the canonical CCLC Opportunity record.
ProposalScope drafts must be versioned and hashed; creating a draft does not authorize sending it.
Price, scope, timing, guarantees, discounts, contract terms and consequential claims remain owner-approved.
No proposal can become APPROVED_FOR_SEND without an exact owner approval permit matching proposal ID, version and hash.
Commercial acceptance must reference the exact proposal version and hash plus authoritative acceptance evidence.
Payment verification is not performed by this module; payment status cannot be invented.
No handoff grants external, production, delivery or money authority.
Unknown external outcome fails closed and is not automatically retried.
Explicit opt-out routes to DO_NOT_CONTACT and blocks conversion outreach.
Duplicate or replayed handoffs must not create duplicate conversion state or duplicate external actions.
